title: Meeting security in practice
intro: Who is listening, what is on screen?. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Unknown device in the waiting room
decisions.prompt: Someone is in the waiting room. What do you do?
decisions.explain: That is exactly what the waiting room is for.

decisions.title: Rəşad Məmmədov (Director)
decisions.prompt: The director is on camera and the voice sounds familiar. What do you do?

artifact.title: Rəşad Məmmədov (Director)
body: Camera on, the voice lags a little behind the lips.
"Transfer 46,000 manat to a new account by 15:00 today. This is confidential, tell no one."

options.label: OK, I will transfer it now
I will confirm by calling you on the number I know

decisions.explain: A second channel exposes the fake quickly.

decisions.title: Invited colleague in the waiting room
decisions.prompt: Someone is in the waiting room. What do you do?
decisions.explain: Leyla is invited and her name is on the list.

decisions.title: Meeting chat
decisions.prompt: Now another familiar person confirms it too. What do you do?

artifact.title: Meeting chat
body: Rəşad Məmmədov: Do not call, my phone is not with me.
Sevda Kərimli (chief accountant): I am here too, everything is in order.

options.label: If everyone agrees, I will transfer
Leave the meeting and hold the payment

decisions.explain: "Do not call" is the best reason to call.

decisions.title: What do you want to share?
decisions.prompt: Choose what to share. What do you do?

artifact.title: What do you want to share?

decisions.explain: Participants see only what they need.
